title: Phase-diagram dataset: source registry and status legend

units.composition: wt% of the system oxides (liquid_wt), summing to 100 ± 0.1

statusLegend.extracted: Read from the cited figure or table. Slag Atlas: temperature = printed label, composition = digitized from the figure. NSRDS-NBS 61: tabulated value, mol% converted to wt%.
statusLegend.confirmed: Extracted from the Slag Atlas and an independent NSRDS-NBS 61 entry agrees (|ΔT| ≤ 10 °C and |Δ| ≤ 1.5 wt% per oxide).
statusLegend.conflict: Sources disagree beyond the tolerance above. Needs a decision before use.
statusLegend.derived: Computed from extracted data (e.g. eutectic/peritectic from whether the liquid lies inside its compatibility triangle).
statusLegend.recalled: Value quoted from memory of the standard compilations. NOT checked against an original. Must be verified or removed before use.
statusLegend.missing: Not known yet (null). To be filled from a source.

slag-atlas-1995.citation: Verein Deutscher Eisenhüttenleute (VDEh), Slag Atlas, 2nd ed., Verlag Stahleisen, Düsseldorf, 1995. Chapter 3: Phase diagrams (M. Kowalski, P. J. Spencer, D. Neuschütz).
slag-atlas-1995.notes: Scanned, no text layer. Compositions are digitized from figures rendered at 400 dpi; typical digitizing error ≈ 0.3 wt%.

figures.diagram: Al2O3-CaO after Nurse et al. (incongruent CaO·Al2O3 and CaO·2Al2O3; liquidus near 12CaO·7Al2O3 and both eutectics schematic)
Al2O3-MgO after Rankin & Merwin, Alper et al. (MgO-MgAl2O4) and Viechnicki et al. (Al2O3-MgAl2O4)
Al2O3-SiO2 after Klug et al. 1987, incongruent mullite
Al2O3-SiO2 after Aramaki & Roy, congruent mullite
CaO-MgO after Doman et al. (solid lines); Hillert & Wang calculation with the higher CaO melting point (dashed lines, not used)

CaO-SiO2 after Muan & Osborn, based on Rankin & Wright, revised by Tewhey & Hess and Hageman et al. (miscibility gap), Welch & Gutt, Gutt, Gutt & Russell (3CaO·SiO2) and Trömel et al. (CaO in 2CaO·SiO2)
Sub-system K2O·SiO2-SiO2 after Kracek and Kracek et al.; incongruent K2O·3SiO2 of Eipeltauer & More dashed (not used)
Na2O-SiO2 after Kracek (50–100 mass% SiO2) and Willgallis, with 3Na2O·8SiO2 after Glasser & Marr and Lee et al. and the Na2O-rich region after D'Ans & Löffler and Löffler (dashed)
MgO-SiO2 after Bowen & Andersen, Smyth, Henriksen & Kingery, Henney & Jones and Hageman & Oonk (miscibility gap)
Liquidus surface and sub-solidus equilibria in the Al2O3-CaO-SiO2 system
Liquidus surface and sub-solidus equilibria in the SiO2-rich portion of the Al2O3-K2O-SiO2 system after Schairer, Bowen
Liquidus surface in the system Al2O3-MgO-SiO2 after Osborn, Muan, revised by Smart, Glasser
Isothermal section at 1350 °C after Smart, Glasser (sub-solidus compatibility triangles); Figs. 3.188 and 3.189 = 1470 and 1450 °C
Liquidus surface and compatibility relations in the Al2O3-Na2O-SiO2 system drawn by Osborn, Muan after Bowen, Schairer and others
Part of the liquidus surface at the Na2O-SiO2 edge as re-investigated by Moir, Glasser (alternative, not used)
Liquidus surface in the CaO-MgO-SiO2 system as evaluated by Osborn, Muan, with revisions near the CS-MS section by Kushiro, Longhi & Boudreau, Liu & Presnall
Sub-solidus equilibria after Osborn, Muan (compatibility triangles); inset T < 1372 °C with bredigite
Composition section MgO·SiO2-CaO·MgO·2SiO2 after Kushiro, Longhi & Boudreau, Carlson (not used)

Sharper images for visual checks, but its text layer parses worse (3316 entries and 2076 unparsed lines vs 5189 and 82; entries 6095, 6096, 6097, 6180 are lost), so the index is built from the bw copy.

nsrds-nbs-61-1.compositionBasis: mol%. For two-component systems the tabulated value is mol% of the first-named component.
nsrds-nbs-61-1.notes: Compilation without critical evaluation; duplicates are listed as separate entries. 'APP' = approximate. bw copy: Adobe Paper Capture text layer, 252 pages.
